drafted_from: tool:wait-for-a-composio-container's row and the stub test tools/composio-connection/test/wait-for-a-composio-container.test.mjs; the container id comes from a live Instagram reel container created on Nov 21 2026 (status FINISHED after about 20 s)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Wait until my Instagram container 18079563326737976 is ready", with the connection id, the owning user id and the container id.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: the caller names the account and the container.
instructions: 1. Create the container first with tool:run-a-composio-action (a proxy POST to /{ig-user-id}/media). Keep the id it returns.
2. Call tool:wait-for-a-composio-container with {account_id, user_id, container_id, max_tries (default 30), every_seconds (default 5)}.

3. Read status_code FINISHED and tries. Only then publish with media_publish. ERROR or EXPIRED, or no FINISHED after max_tries, is refused with the last status: the container will not publish; create a new one.

worked_examples.title: Wait for a reel container before publishing it
worked_examples.ask: Wait until my reel container is ready
worked_examples.given: A reel container the app is still processing.
